description: This file declares cryptographic random number generation functions within the Thunder::Crypto namespace, including external functions for various integer types, inline functions for signed types, and a template function for range-based randomization.

methods.name: Random(int8_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int8_t by reinterpreting it as uint8_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(int16_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int16_t by reinterpreting it as uint16_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(int32_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int32_t by reinterpreting it as uint32_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(int64_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int64_t by reinterpreting it as uint64_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(DESTTYPE& value, const DESTTYPE minimum, const DESTTYPE maximum)
methods.description: Template function that generates a random value within a specified range by calling the Crypto::Random function and adjusting the result to fit within [minimum, maximum].
